title: A bounded job
summary: A job starts and completes; checker results describe only this small model.
scope: One job; no retries or external services.
subject: Job lifecycle

rules.label: Job state stays in its declared domain
rules.provenance: Explicit fixture rule for a finite qualification model.

files.name: Job.tla
files.content:
---- MODULE Job ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLE pc
Init == pc = 0
Start == /\ pc = 0 /\ pc' = 1
Finish == /\ pc = 1 /\ pc' = 2
Stay == /\ pc = 2 /\ UNCHANGED pc
Next == Start \/ Finish \/ Stay
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_pc
Safe == pc \in 0..2
NoDone == pc < 2
NeverDone == pc # 2
EventuallyDone == <>(pc = 2)
====

diagram.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
  state "Ready" as ready
  state "Working" as running
  state "Complete" as done
  [*] --> ready
  ready --> running : Start work
  running --> done : Finish work

check.bounds: pc in 0..2; one worker; 60 seconds; 512 MiB heap. Internal stuttering is omitted from the overview.

reproduction.detail: Design fixture without an implementation; TLC is model evidence only.

omissions: External services, concurrency, retry and internal stuttering.

toolchain.regeneration: Use mex-statechart to regenerate a new preview with the recorded model and config.
